_comment: Production overrides only. Do NOT put real secrets in this file — it is committed to source control. Every value below is intentionally blank/placeholder and MUST be supplied via environment variables (or your hosting provider's secret manager) on the actual server. ASP.NET Core reads environment variables with '__' as the section separator, e.g. ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection, Email__Smtp__Password, AdminSeed__Email, AdminSeed__Password.
